cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(s116_ui_test VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(S116_JUCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Optional local JUCE checkout (e.g. a fetched juce-src)")
if(S116_JUCE_DIR AND EXISTS "${S116_JUCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(STATUS "S116: using local JUCE at ${S116_JUCE_DIR}")
    add_subdirectory("${S116_JUCE_DIR}" JUCE)
else()
    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Declare(JUCE GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE.git GIT_TAG 8.0.6)
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(JUCE)
endif()

add_subdirectory(.. ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/s116_ui)

juce_add_console_app(s116_ui_test)
target_sources(s116_ui_test PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(s116_ui_test PRIVATE s116_ui juce::juce_audio_processors juce::juce_gui_basics juce::juce_core)
option(S116_LCD_COMBO "Use LCD dropdowns" OFF)
if(S116_LCD_COMBO OR S116_LCD_COMBO STREQUAL "1" OR S116_LCD_COMBO STREQUAL "ON" OR S116_LCD_COMBO STREQUAL "TRUE")
    target_compile_definitions(s116_ui_test PRIVATE S116_LCD_COMBO=1)
endif()
message(STATUS "S116_LCD_COMBO=${S116_LCD_COMBO}")
target_compile_definitions(s116_ui_test PRIVATE JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0 JUCE_USE_CURL=0)
